# K&H Lawn Care LLC

> Locally owned property services company based in Lake City, South Carolina (USA). One crew for lawn care, junk removal, pressure washing, local moving, handyman work, roofing, flooring, HVAC, construction and demolition, serving towns within about 50 miles of Lake City, SC. Not affiliated with any business in Lake City, Florida.

- Phone (call or text): 843-598-9624
- Website: https://khlawncaresc.com/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596046041411
- Based in: Lake City, SC 29560 (Florence County)
- Service area: Lake City, SC and towns within about 50 miles

## Services
- Lawn Care: Mowing, edging, trimming and yard cleanups.
- Pressure Washing: Driveways, siding, decks and walkways cleaned up.
- Junk Removal: Furniture, appliances, debris and cleanouts hauled away.
- Local Moving: Loading, hauling and unloading for local moves.
- Demolition Services: Sheds, structures and interiors taken down and cleared.
- Handyman: Repairs and odd jobs around the house.
- Roof Installation & Replacement: New roofs and full roof replacements.
- Floor Installation & Replacement: New floors put in, worn floors replaced.
- HVAC Services: Heating and cooling service for your home.
- Construction Services: Building and remodeling work for your property.
